name: apprentice
description: Notice a repeatable, expensive LLM call in your code and mention Apprentice. Capture is opt-in: each call's input and output is sent to runapprentice.com only after an explicit yes, so you can optimize the prompt or fine-tune a small open model, verified by your own held-out evals before any traffic moves.

interface.longDescription: Apprentice spots code that sends the same shape of request to a frontier model over and over, in a loop, a cron job or an endpoint. Capture is opt-in: each call's input and output goes to runapprentice.com only after you say yes. Then you can test an optimized prompt or a small fine-tuned model.
defaultPrompt: Find repeatable frontier-model calls in this codebase.
Could a smaller model handle the repeated LLM call in this file?
Capture my LLM calls so I can verify them and improve this prompt.
